protocol.design: one-factor-at-a-time; all other simulation parameters held at the central setting
protocol.aggregation: NDCG retention is 100 times the mean CL-MEE NDCG@5 across seeds divided by the mean RankOnly NDCG@5 across the same seeds, matching the manuscript table; per-seed ratios are retained in the raw CSV. Other reported metrics are means and sample SD across the ten fixed seeds.

weight_training.message: CONVERGENCE: NORM OF PROJECTED GRADIENT <= PGTOL

protocol.split: per-user chronological 80/10/10; validation and test targets restricted to training-seen POIs
protocol.test_candidate_order: target first, then nearest candidates, then popularity-focused candidates; stable descending score sort; ties preserve candidate order

comparison_anchor_sensitivity.interpretation: The common-runner-up policy is a sensitivity analysis; the primary method remains the hybrid reference convention stated in the paper.

runtime.note: Wall-clock measurements from this execution environment; rerun on target hardware for deployment claims.

positive_negative_example.note: One anonymized observed test transition; values are model contribution differences, not causal effects.
